name: normfit
expr: [mu1, sd1, muci1, sdci1] = normfit(x); [mu2, sd2, muci2, sdci2] = normfit(x, 0.05, cens); [mu3, sd3, muci3, sdci3] = normfit(x, 0.05, [], freq); [mu4, sd4, muci4, sdci4] = normfit(x, 0.05, cens, freq);
comment: Sig: [mu, sd, muci, sdci] = normfit(x[, alpha[, censoring[, freq[, options]]]]). MLE for normal: mu=mean, sd=sample std (N-1). Closed-form weighted moments when freq alone; EM iteration on truncated-normal moments + analytic Fisher info Wald CI when censored. Default alpha=0.05. Shares the `normal_fit_mle` helper with lognfit.
